criteria.check: Binarize gripper state at 0.5. Count rising edges from open (<0.5) to closed (>0.5). PASS iff count == 1 in full episode; FAIL if 0 or >=2, indicating missed grasp and retry.
criteria.name: Single grasp attempt on first try

criteria.check: After first gripper close until gripper re-opens for release, compute per-frame pixel distance between gripper bbox center and object bbox center. PASS iff distance stays <100 pixels and/or bbox IoU >0.05 in all frames. FAIL if distance >100 pixels for >5 consecutive frames, indicating slip or drop.
criteria.name: No drop - object stays with gripper during transport

criteria.check: Watch exterior cameras and wrist camera: PASS iff object is released over the target and comes to rest fully inside target boundaries at episode end, not on rim, outside, or falling out. FAIL otherwise.
criteria.name: Object placed inside target

criteria.check: From xyz at 15 Hz compute Euclidean end-effector speed per step and smooth with 5-sample (0.33 s) moving average. A pause is speed <0.02 m/s continuously for >2.0 s (>30 samples). Require zero such pauses for full score.
criteria.name: No long pauses
